scripts.check: bun run check:boundaries && bun run check:public && bun run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/protocol typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/console typecheck && bun run build:packages && bun run --cwd npm-packages/dashboard typecheck
scripts.build:packages: bun run --cwd packages/protocol build && bun run --cwd packages/console build
scripts.build:console: bun run build:packages && bun run --cwd npm-packages/dashboard build:embedded
scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run --cwd npm-packages/dashboard build
scripts.test:console:e2e: bun run build:console && playwright test --config playwright.console.config.ts
